label: Maximum paid parental leave payment (per week, before tax)
context: Applies from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. The maximum is the same however many children are born at the same time.

label: Minimum paid parental leave payment for a self-employed person (per week, before tax)
context: Applies from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. A self-employed person who makes a loss or earns less than the minimum wage while working at least 10 hours a week receives this amount.

label: Weeks of paid parental leave payments
context: A continuous period of 26 weeks (6 months) while the person is not working. Payments stop if they return to work before the 26 weeks are up or stop being the primary carer.
